tagline: Kai devices, ek public address: tumhara home router ise kaise share karta hai.
description: Ghar ke devices 192.168.1.10 jaise private addresses use karte hain jinka internet par koi matlab nahi. Home router har outgoing packet ko apne ek public address aur apne chune hue port ke saath rewrite karta hai, is badlav ko table mein likh leta hai, aur replies ke liye ulta kar deta hai. Jo packets kisi ne maange hi nahi, unki table entry nahi hoti, isliye woh drop ho jate hain.
facts: Network + transport (IP aur ports rewrite karta hai)

normal.name: Do devices ek address share karte hain
normal.summary: Laptop aur phone dono ek hi public IP se same server tak pahunchte hain; router unhe port se alag rakhta hai.

steps.title: Laptop se nikalte hue
steps.detail: Laptop web server se connection kholta hai. Laptop se nikalte waqt packet mein laptop ka private address aur uska apna temporary port, 51234, hota hai. Agar yeh aise hi internet par jaye, to server kabhi jawab nahi de sakta: 192.168.1.10 laakhon gharon mein exist karta hai.

steps.title: Translate hua
steps.detail: Router source address ko apne public address se aur source port ko ek free port, 40001, se badal deta hai. Woh apni NAT table mein ek line likhta hai: 192.168.1.10:51234 ↔ 198.51.100.7:40001, to 203.0.113.10:443. Kyunki addresses aur port badal gaye, woh IP aur TCP checksums bhi dobara nikalta hai.

options: Source address, source port, TTL aur checksums
quiz.why: Port address translation source address aur port rewrite karta hai. TTL kisi bhi router ki tarah ek kam hota hai, aur dono checksums theek karne padte hain kyunki woh badle hue fields ko cover karte hain.

steps.title: Reply, wapas translate hua
steps.detail: Server ko hamesha sirf 198.51.100.7:40001 dikhta hai, isliye woh wahin reply karta hai. Router table mein port 40001 dekhta hai, laptop ko dhoondh leta hai, aur andar bhejne se pehle destination ko wapas 192.168.1.10:51234 mein rewrite kar deta hai.

quiz.q: SYN-ACK 198.51.100.7:40001 ke liye aata hai. Router use kahan bhejta hai?
quiz.why: Pichhle step mein bani table entry outside port 40001 ko wapas laptop ke address aur port se map karti hai.

steps.title: Phone bhi judta hai
steps.desc: Same server, same inside port, alag outside port
steps.detail: Phone bhi port 51234 hi chun leta hai aur same server se connect karta hai. 40001 dobara use karne se dono connections gadbad ho jate, isliye router 40002 chunta hai. Yahi PAT ka “port” hissa hai: ek public address, port number se alag pehchane gaye.
facts: Lagbhag 64,000 flows per protocol aur server

quiz.q: Router phone ke liye port 40001 dobara kyun nahi use kar sakta?
options: Ports kabhi reuse nahi ho sakte
40001 ke replies ambiguous hote: laptop ya phone?
quiz.why: Dono connections same server aur port par ja rahe hain. Sirf outside port unke replies ko alag batata hai, isliye har ek ko apna chahiye.

steps.title: Entries expire hoti hain
steps.desc: FIN band karta hai, timer safai karta hai
steps.detail: Jab laptop FIN se apna connection band karta hai, router use kisi bhi aur packet ki tarah translate karta hai aur phir entry ki umar kuch seconds kar deta hai. Idle connections ki entries apne aap expire hoti hain: UDP ke liye minutes, khule TCP connection ke liye ghante. Phir port 40001 dobara free ho jata hai.
facts: Seconds mein hata di jati hai

outro.title: Ek address, kai devices
outro.text: Router ne har private address aur port ko apne public address aur ek unique port se badla, badlav yaad rakha, aur replies ke liye ulta kiya. Server ne kabhi private address nahi dekha, aur laptop aur phone ko translation ka pata hi nahi chala.

inbound.name: Unsolicited inbound aur port forwarding
inbound.summary: Ek dost bahar se NAS tak pahunchne ki koshish karta hai. Table entry na hone se woh drop ho jata hai, jab tak port forward na jode.

steps.title: Bahar se dastak
steps.detail: Ek dost home NAS ki photo site kholna chahta hai. Use sirf public address pata hai, isliye woh 198.51.100.7 port 8443 se connect karta hai. Router ke paas port 8443 ki koi table entry nahi hai: andar kisi ne yeh baat-cheet shuru hi nahi ki thi.

quiz.q: Router is SYN ka kya karta hai?
options: Andar ke har device ko bhejta hai
Drop kar deta hai: koi mapping nahi hai
Jo pehla device mile use bhejta hai
Khud web page se reply karta hai
quiz.why: NAT ko sirf andar se shuru hue connections ke replies ka rasta pata hota hai. Entry aur rule ke bina packet ke jaane ki koi jagah nahi.

steps.title: Port forward jodo
steps.detail: Router ki settings mein owner ek port forwarding rule jodta hai: TCP port 8443 par jo bhi aaye woh NAS ko, 192.168.1.50 port 443 par, jata hai. Yeh ek permanent table entry hai jo ulti direction mein kaam karti hai: bahar se andar.
facts: NAS ab poore internet ke liye khula hai

steps.title: Andar forward hua
steps.desc: Destination NAS ke liye rewrite hua
steps.detail: Dost ka browser dobara try karta hai. Is baar router rule se match karta hai, destination ko 192.168.1.50:443 mein rewrite karta hai, aur connection ko apni table mein record karta hai taaki replies wapas ka rasta dhoondh sakein. Source dost ka asli address hi rehta hai.

quiz.q: Port forwarding mein andar aate waqt kaunsa address rewrite hota hai?
quiz.why: Inbound forwarding destination NAT hai: public destination andar ka device ban jata hai. Outgoing NAT iske bajaye source rewrite karta hai.

steps.title: Reply wapas bahar jata hai
steps.detail: NAS 192.168.1.50:443 se jawab deta hai. Router badlav ulta kar deta hai taaki dost ko reply 198.51.100.7:8443 se aata dikhe, bilkul wahin jahan usne dastak di thi. Connection chal jata hai.

outro.title: Default mein band, rule se khula
outro.text: NAT un packets ko drop kar deta hai jo andar se shuru hue connection se match nahi karte, jo ek basic firewall jaisa kaam karta hai. Port forward ek fixed rule hai jo ek outside port ko ek inside device tak pahunchne deta hai. Sirf wahi kholo jo zaroori ho, aur us device ko updated rakho.
